_doc: Wave 3 tier C fill (2026-11-25): the coal road, the anvil hall's hammers, the polishing house and the star mine.

people.role: Steward of the coal road from Thạch Thán Khoáng to the forge, under Hầu Thiết Anh
people.backstory: Keeps the coal road from Thạch Thán Khoáng to the forge and counts every basket that goes up it; he has told Hầu Thiết Anh (hau_thiet_anh) twice that the upper gallery will slide in a wet winter, and twice been told to dig faster.

tree.intent: Metal body with Water under it; carries the forge's weight.

people.appearance: A basket-strap groove worn into each shoulder, and a tally cord knotted round his wrist.

people.role: Second hammer of the anvil hall and Cát Đoán Nhạc's sworn brother
people.backstory: Has struck the second hammer to Cát Đoán Nhạc's (cat_doan_nhac) first for eighty years and says a rite taught to a steppe boy will leave the mountain with him; he counts Đinh Hỏa Lân's (dinh_hoa_lan) folds at the anvil, waiting for one short of nine. He has cracked two third-hammer boys' wrists for missing the beat; Ông Thiết Xuyên (ong_thiet_xuyen) is the second.

ties.note: the Rite should stay on the mountain
outer apprentice and third hammer of the anvil hall, a star-mine boy

tree.intent: Metal hide that hardens under blows.

people.appearance: His beard is singed to a flat line along the jaw, and the hammer has deafened his left ear.

people.role: Inner disciple of the anvil hall, Cát Thối Phong's son, raised by his uncle
people.backstory: Cát Thối Phong's (cat_thoi_phong) son, left on the mountain with his uncle while his father keeps the Pivot's forge; he answers his father's letters about the halberd with news of the anvil, and has no Fire, which is the one thing his grandfather ever asks him about.
people.appearance: No scars at all, which the hall thinks improper.

people.role: Outer apprentice of the polishing house, from the calamine camp
people.backstory: An orphan of the calamine camp at Lô Cam Khoáng, she came up a year behind Đàm Kính Nguyệt (dam_kinh_nguyet) and polishes the blades the gate sells to Phất Y Cốc; she would rather carry one on a hire, and mutters the valley's verse at the wheel.

tree.intent: Metal edge; wants a sword more than a wheel.

people.appearance: A polishing-paste stain across one cheek that she wears like a seal; her heel taps the treadle out of time.

people.role: Outer apprentice, a coal-carrier's daughter who wants the pool
people.backstory: Kha Thán Sinh's (kha_than_sinh) younger sister, who carried coal before she could count; the saying is that quench-keepers are coal-carriers' sons, and every week she asks Bàng Lãnh Tôi (bang_lanh_toi) to let a daughter carry the tongs.

tree.intent: Metal with Water under it; a quench-keeper's root.

people.appearance: Coal ground so deep into her palms that the creases look inked.

people.role: Inner disciple and seller at the gate of Thiên Ngoại Khoáng
people.backstory: A mine factor's son and Hầu Thiết Anh's (hau_thiet_anh) best seller at the mine gate, who can tell a buyer how star iron sings without ever having heard it; he thinks Mẫn Hắc Châu's (man_hac_chau) weighing is jealousy and says so, and has twice sold buyers her weighed lots under his own tally and kept her gate tip.

ties.note: outer apprentice and third hammer of the anvil hall, a star-mine boy

people.appearance: A gap-toothed grin, a too-fine blue coat, and a little bell sewn at the cuff to announce himself.

people.role: Outer apprentice and third hammer of the anvil hall, a star-mine boy
people.backstory: A bonded digger's boy from the star mine who swings the third hammer under Nghê Bách Đoán (nghe_bach_doan); he heard so often that the Rite would leave the mountain with the steppe boy that he said it to Đinh Hỏa Lân's (dinh_hoa_lan) face, and carried coal for a month for it.
people.appearance: Swings left-handed; the right wrist is wrapped in a strip of red cloth.
